question: What is the average projected monthly sales in USD for France in 2021, considering only product sales with promotions where promo_total_id = 1 and channels where channel_total_id = 1, by taking each product’s monthly sales from 2019 and 2020, calculating the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 for that same product and month, applying this growth rate to project 2021 monthly sales, converting all projected 2021 amounts to USD with the 2021 exchange rates, and finally averaging and listing them by month?
sql:
WITH historical_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN channels ch ON s.channel_id = ch.channel_id
    JOIN promotions p ON s.promo_id = p.promo_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        h2019.prod_id,
        h2019.calendar_month_number,
        h2020.monthly_sales as sales_2020,
        h2019.monthly_sales as sales_2019,
        ((h2020.monthly_sales - h2019.monthly_sales) / h2019.monthly_sales) as growth_rate,
        ((h2020.monthly_sales - h2019.monthly_sales) / h2019.monthly_sales) * h2020.monthly_sales + h2020.monthly_sales as projected_2021_sales
    FROM historical_sales h2019
    JOIN historical_sales h2020 ON h2019.prod_id = h2020.prod_id AND h2019.calendar_month_number = h2020.calendar_month_number
    WHERE h2019.calendar_year = 2019
      AND h2020.calendar_year = 2020
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        p.*,
        c2.to_us as exchange_rate
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN currency c2 ON 'France' = c2.country AND 2021 = c2.year AND p.calendar_month_number = c2.month
),
averaged_by_month AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        AVG(projected_2021_sales * exchange_rate) as avg_projected_2021_usd
    FROM with_currency
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
    ORDER BY calendar_month_number
)
